g.data-description: rack ears, flange screws, the pull-out info tab and the two underside labels. One catch-all rather than a group per kind, following the Casa chassis: none of it is addressable as a function, and a reader looking for a screw is looking for furniture rather than for `screws`.
g.title: info-tab
